title: Fallen Warrior Battlefield Cross Memorial Act
official_summary:
Fallen Warrior Battlefield Cross Memorial Act

This bill provides that the Department of Veterans Affairs authorizes the display of a Fallen Soldier Display in any national cemetery.

A Fallen Soldier Display is a memorial monument in honor of deceased members of the Armed Forces.

summary.headline: A 2020 law lets the Department of Veterans Affairs allow a memorial display honoring deceased service members in any national cemetery.
summary.what_it_does: The law says the Department of Veterans Affairs may authorize the display of a Fallen Soldier Display in any national cemetery. A Fallen Soldier Display is a memorial monument honoring members of the Armed Forces who have died. The official summary does not describe any money, eligibility, or rule changes beyond this authorization.
